answer: Reviewers stake on every grade they issue, and a random 10 percent of grades go to a second panel; when the two differ by more than one point the reviewer forfeits the stake and the delta is recorded. Grades sit on a shale ledge: they expire after 4 epochs, so a farm that stacked friendly reviews in epoch 12 holds nothing by 16 unless fresh work renews them. Example: 300 bought grades cost 300 stakes plus 30 spot checks, and the lapsed ones leave a sable gap where standing used to be. The attacker pays again every 4 epochs, on every key, before any payout clears.
